core_intent.description: A structured adversarial method for attacking high-level framework claims by first controlling definitions, then opening exposed bridge assumptions, then running matched mathematical and simulation ablations.
core_intent.inspiration: Chess attacking principles translated into formal falsification procedure.
core_intent.primary_rule: Do not attack downstream application claims until the core bridge dependencies are locked and isolated.

control_center.formal_meaning: Lock the core definitions and dependency chain before testing.

develop_pieces.chess_meaning: Bring pieces into coordinated attacking positions.
develop_pieces.formal_meaning: Construct matched model variants before evaluation.

open_files.formal_meaning: Expose the vulnerable bridge claim directly.

sacrifice.chess_meaning: Remove material to expose the king.
sacrifice.formal_meaning: Deliberately remove one claimed support mechanism and test whether the result still survives.

attack_king.formal_meaning: Attack the strongest claim, not a weak paraphrase.
attack_king.king_claim: Stable non-collapsing triadic closure requires orientation-conditioned admissibility plus residue support.

avoid_premature_attack.chess_meaning: Do not attack before pieces are coordinated.
avoid_premature_attack.formal_meaning: Do not test gravity_app, matter_app, field_app, or QM/GR bridge claims until lower bridge claims survive ablation.

formal_claim_under_attack.claim: Stable non-collapsing triadic closure requires orientation-conditioned admissibility plus residue support.
formal_chain: TC_asym or K stabilizes if closure persists

M4_random_admissibility.description: Admissibility replaced by matched random filter.

primary_test.condition: M0_full_mechanism must outperform every ablated model by threshold tau.
primary_test.falsifier: If any ablated model equals or exceeds M0 within tau, the strong claim fails.

orientation_test.condition: Orientation coherence must predict closure survival.
orientation_test.falsifier: If orientation coherence has near-zero predictive value, the orientation-closure bridge fails.

residue_test.condition: History-conditioned residue must improve closure survival over shuffled or erased residue.
residue_test.falsifier: If shuffled/no-residue variants survive equally, residue support is not required.

symmetry_test.condition: Forced symmetry should reduce directional closure stability.
symmetry_test.falsifier: If symmetric distinction performs equally, asymmetry requirement is weakened or false.

admissibility_test.falsifier: If random admissibility performs equally, delta_a is not carrying the claimed burden.

decision_gate.support: M0 significantly outperforms all ablated controls across seeds.
decision_gate.downgrade: M0 weakly outperforms controls or depends on narrow tuned parameters.
decision_gate.falsify: Any broken model matches or exceeds M0 under matched conditions.

governance_rules: No downstream app claim may be tested until upstream bridge dependencies are isolated.
Every claim must identify its king_claim before attack begins.
Every simulation must include at least one matched-random control.
Every survival result must report seed variance.
Every support claim must survive ablation, not merely produce interesting behavior.
Premature application projection is prohibited during bridge falsification.
